title: Geometry as a Missing Axis of Representation Quality: The Variational Geometric Information Bottleneck under Data Scarcity
abstract: arXiv:2511.02496v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study latent geometry as an explicit component of representation quality in data-scarce learning. For an encoder (\phi), we define (Q_{\beta,\gamma}(\phi)=I(\phi(X);Y)-\beta\mathcal C(\phi)-\gamma d_{\mathrm{int}}(\phi)), combining task-relevant information with penalties for curvature and intrinsic latent dimension. Thus geometry becomes part of the bottleneck criterion, not only a post hoc diagnostic.   Under smooth-manifold, loss-transfer, and estimator-concentration assumptions, we derive non-asymptotic low-label generalization bounds where intrinsic dimension and covering complexity enter explicitly. We characterize the information--geometry frontier and prove empirical-surrogate consistency. The analysis links encoder geometry to learning through latent covering numbers, loss-class entropy, and uniform deviation.   We instantiate the theory as \texttt{V-GIB}, adding curvature and dimension penalties to variational bottleneck

translated_title: 几何：表征质量的缺失维度——数据稀缺条件下的变分几何信息瓶颈
translated_abstract: 我们研究潜空间几何在数据稀缺学习中作为表征质量的显式组成部分。对于编码器 φ，我们定义 Q_{β,γ}(φ) = I(φ(X);Y) − βC(φ) − γd_int(φ)，将任务相关信息与曲率惩罚及内在潜维度惩罚相结合。由此，几何成为瓶颈准则的一部分，而不仅仅是事后诊断工具。在光滑流形、损失迁移以及估计量集中性假设下，我们推导出非渐近的低标签泛化界，其中内在维度和覆盖复杂性显式地出现在界中。我们刻画了信息—几何前沿，并证明了经验代理的一致性。该分析通过潜空间覆盖数、损失类熵和一致偏差，将编码器几何与学习过程联系起来。我们将该理论实例化为 V-GIB，在变分信息瓶颈中加入曲率和维度惩罚。
tldr: 该论文首次将潜空间几何（曲率与内在维度）显式纳入信息瓶颈目标函数，提出 V-GIB 框架，并在数据稀缺场景下推导出几何量显式参与的非渐近低标签泛化界。
